### Time-Averaged Fits

```{r age_avg_grid}
# One gear's time-averaged age-comp fit at a time, switched with a
# dropdown, rather than every gear squashed into one small-multiples
# grid -- each gear's own age range and proportions are only legible
# at a size a full-width single panel gives them. A gear with no real
# observed age data is left out of the dropdown entirely, even when a
# model-computed expected proportion exists for it anyway (a gear
# outside the estimation model's own fitted-fleet set still gets a
# selectivity-implied expected proportion -- it was just never fit
# against any real data, so there's nothing for this panel to compare
# it to). Filtering on obs rather than obs-or-pred is deliberate: pred
# alone is not evidence this gear has any age data.
age_fleets <- unique(mv$age_comp_fits$fleet)
age_sexes  <- unique(mv$age_comp_fits$sex)
fc <- mv_fleet_colours(fleet_names = age_fleets)

valid_fleets <- Filter(function(fl) {
  sub <- mv$age_comp_fits[mv$age_comp_fits$fleet == fl, , drop = FALSE]
  nrow(sub) > 0 && any(!is.na(sub$obs))
}, age_fleets)

if (length(valid_fleets) == 0L) {
  htmltools::div("No age composition data or fit available for any gear.")
} else {
  default_fl   <- valid_fleets[1]
  trace_ranges <- list()
  trace_cursor <- 0L
  p <- plot_ly()

  for (fl in valid_fleets) {
    idx_this  <- integer(0)
    fl_visible <- identical(fl, default_fl)
    for (sx in age_sexes) {
      sub <- mv$age_comp_fits[
        mv$age_comp_fits$fleet == fl &
          mv$age_comp_fits$sex == sx,
        , drop = FALSE
      ]
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

      avg_obs <- tapply(
        X = sub$obs, INDEX = sub$age,
        FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE
      )
      avg_pred <- tapply(
        X = sub$pred, INDEX = sub$age,
        FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE
      )
      avg_ages <- as.numeric(names(avg_obs))

      multi_sex <- length(age_sexes) > 1
      sx_extra  <- if (multi_sex) paste0(" (", sx, ")") else ""

      # Observed: grey bars
      p <- add_bars(
        p = p,
        x = avg_ages, y = as.numeric(avg_obs),
        marker = list(
          color = "rgba(180,180,180,0.6)",
          line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)
        ),
        visible = fl_visible, showlegend = FALSE,
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "Age %{x}: %{y:.4f}<extra>Obs", sx_extra, "</extra>"
        )
      )
      idx_this <- c(idx_this, trace_cursor); trace_cursor <- trace_cursor + 1L

      # Predicted: coloured line + points, one trace -- a separate
      # markers-only trace sitting on top of a separate line-only
      # trace (even with hoverinfo="skip" on the markers) leaves the
      # line with no working hover at the marker's own x position,
      # which is most of the line's length at this point density. One
      # "lines+markers" trace with a single hovertemplate has no such
      # gap.
      p <- add_trace(
        p = p, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        x = avg_ages, y = as.numeric(avg_pred),
        line = list(color = fc[fl], width = 1.5),
        marker = list(
          color = fc[fl], size = 4,
          line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)
        ),
        visible = fl_visible,
        showlegend = multi_sex, name = sx,
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "Age %{x}: %{y:.4f}<extra>Pred", sx_extra, "</extra>"
        )
      )
      idx_this <- c(idx_this, trace_cursor); trace_cursor <- trace_cursor + 1L
    }
    trace_ranges[[fl]] <- idx_this
  }

  n_traces <- trace_cursor
  gear_buttons <- lapply(valid_fleets, function(fl) {
    vis <- rep(FALSE, n_traces)
    vis[trace_ranges[[fl]] + 1L] <- TRUE
    list(label = fl, method = "restyle",
        args = list(list(visible = as.list(vis))))
  })

  lay <- modelVis::mv_layout()
  lay$xaxis$title <- "Age"
  lay$yaxis$title <- "Mean proportion"
  lay$barmode     <- "overlay"
  lay$updatemenus <- list(list(
    type = "dropdown", direction = "down", active = 0L,
    x = 0.0, xanchor = "left", y = 1.12, yanchor = "bottom",
    buttons = gear_buttons
  ))
  p <- do.call(what = layout, args = c(list(p = p), lay))
  modelVis::mv_config(p = p)
}
```

```{r age_resid_bubble_heading, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=!is.null(mv$age_comp_resids) && !identical(meta$show_age_resid_bubbles, FALSE)}
cat("\n### Residual Bubbles\n")
```

```{r age_resid_bubble, eval=!is.null(mv$age_comp_resids) && !identical(meta$show_age_resid_bubbles, FALSE)}
if (!is.null(mv$age_comp_resids)) {
  resid_plots <- list()
  for (fl in age_fleets) {
    sub <- mv$age_comp_resids[
      mv$age_comp_resids$fleet == fl,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
    p <- mv_plot_bubble(
      df    = sub,
      x_col = "year",
      y_col = "age",
      title = fl
    )
    resid_plots[[length(resid_plots) + 1L]] <- p
  }
  if (length(resid_plots) == 1L) {
    resid_plots[[1]]
  } else {
    htmltools::tagList(resid_plots)
  }
}
```

```{r age_yearly_heading, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=!identical(meta$show_age_yearly_fits, FALSE)}
cat("\n### Yearly Fits\n")
```

```{r age_yearly_grid, eval=!identical(meta$show_age_yearly_fits, FALSE)}
# Per fleet x sex yearly comp grid
plot_list <- list()
for (fl in age_fleets) {
  for (sx in age_sexes) {
    sub <- mv$age_comp_fits[
      mv$age_comp_fits$fleet == fl &
        mv$age_comp_fits$sex == sx,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
    lbl <- if (length(age_sexes) > 1) {
      paste(fl, "-", sx)
    } else {
      fl
    }
    p <- mv_plot_comp_grid(
      df      = sub,
      bin_col = "age",
      ylab    = "Proportion"
    )
    p <- layout(p = p, title = lbl)
    plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1L]] <- p
  }
}
if (length(plot_list) == 1L) {
  plot_list[[1]]
} else {
  htmltools::tagList(plot_list)
}
```
